clock_guard.fault_recovery: Only construction of a new guard instance; no automatic reset
clock_guard.threshold_scope: Predeclared engineering consistency budgets, not physical calibration or a bound on sensor-to-FCU timestamp error

startup_ascii_policy: Preserve the old pre-first-frame option; additionally allow the exact single AP_IRLock_SITL::init() LF line once within 10 seconds of the first valid from-FCU frame, with original bytes and assembly ledger
fault_response_policy: Do not forward a clock-rejected source or clamp its timestamp. Revoke local readiness; report FCU sampled health independently. Natural host clock faults may preempt the source-pause control; retain and label that outcome.
epoch_monotonic_candidate: Offline arithmetic comparison only; not deployed to MAVROS/AP in this phase
mission_integration: Readiness is observed only; no new armed trial or claim of fixing the mission arm/takeoff recheck race
scope: Unarmed clock-guard and sampled-FCU-health diagnostic only. SYS_STATUS vision health is not a per-frame ACK or EKF fusion proof. Both original B2 FAIL runs and B1 INCOMPLETE remain unchanged.
